fusions.name: Kicked Boulder
fusions.desc: You kick a boulder out of the ground at the first enemy in line for 30 damage. It bursts on impact, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Stamped Fault
fusions.desc: You stamp and the ground jolts, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning them for 1 second. Each hit has a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bedrock Stance
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Cobble-Sure
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 15%. You carry 8% earth resistance.
